7.name: In the Name of My Father's Father's Father / From Paella to Grill
7.overview: The Cesaronis return to Garbatella, more relaxed than ever. Giulio runs the wine shop with Augusto, unaware of what's about to befall him. Marco is about to say his wedding vows to Virginia, with whom he has Adriano. Mimmo makes his debut as a special education teacher at school: Stefania is the principal, while Rudi works as a janitor in the hallways. Marta, Marco and Eva's daughter, arrives from America. Soon the balance will change.

7.name: Botanical Obtorto / A Bear in the Kitchen
7.overview: Giulio and Livia, shocked by Carlo's refusal to work at the wine shop, become convinced that he's involved in shady dealings. Meanwhile, Walter tries to sabotage himself so as not to become Virginia's sous chef. Marta, increasingly obsessed with Jonathan, tries to make him jealous by showing herself and Olmo at the botanical garden, but obviously the plan fails. Despite themselves, the two young people are involved in a clandestine party, and Marco, called to intervene, is now truly angry with his daughter.

7.name: Grandpa, no Love / The Inauguration
7.overview: Giulio and Carlo try to help Adriano win over his beloved Federica. Their disastrous advice puts Adriano under pressure from his terrible partner Renato, but the arrival of Rovazzi will set things right! Walter supports Virginia in creating the new menu. Marco, discovering Marta's crush on Jonathan, creates a fake profile for him to talk to his daughter, unleashing the girl's ire. Father and daughter have just reconciled when Marta receives a call from Eva: she must return to New York immediately.

7.name: You Can Ask Me For Anything Except Money
7.overview: After yet another argument, Carlo leaves the restaurant; Giulio and Livia attempt to reconcile. Adriano, without filters, reveals truths that prompt Virginia to reflect. Marco and Marta leave for Milan to convince Eva to leave her in Rome; Olmo and Pedro plot long-distance support. Mimmo and Ines begin to open up, but an unexpected event calls into question.

7.name: The First Times
7.overview: To avoid foreclosure, Livia calls upon Aunt Teresa and organizes a fake wedding, with Stefania orchestrating. Marta and Olmo search for a common ground, a mixture of modesty and enthusiasm. In the kitchen, Virginia faces a crucial test cooking for Diana Canà, while Marco harbors a secret he confides only to Walter. Between masks and confessions, the family tests a new course.

7.name: The Right Feeling
7.overview: Marco, increasingly gloomy after returning from Milan, alarms Adriano. Mimmo is down: things aren't going well with Ines. Preparations for Adriano's party are going badly: the toy car arrived broken and the location has been cancelled. Giulio and Carlo take matters into their own hands. Virginia sees a call on Walter's phone: her doubts about Marco's illness grow. Stefania suffers from love.

7.name: Shards
7.overview: Marco, increasingly doubtful and tormented, hesitates to talk to Virginia. Lidia invites a chef to the restaurant to try Virginia's dishes, but, distracted by her problems with Marco, she fails. But Giulio, Lidia, and Carlo give her a second chance. Marco confesses; Virginia, hurt, walks away and leaves for a cooking internship.

7.name: It Thundered So Much That It Rained / The Beginning of the End
7.overview: Marco's confession overwhelms Virginia, who accepts the internship to get away. Giulio realizes the crisis is brewing when Carlo reveals the truth about Milan: he rushes to his son and entrusts the business to Carlo and Livia, with Adriano's help. A financial police audit forces a painful choice between friendship and the winery. Walter approaches Virginia to apologize and confess his feelings; Marco goes to her to clarify, but finds them in the same room. Exhausted, Giulio considers selling and closing down.

overview: Giulio is a widower, struggling to raise three sons, Marco, Rudi, and Mimmo, as best he can. He lives in Rome's working-class Garbatella neighborhood and runs a wine shop with his two brothers. Lucia, meanwhile, comes from Milan's middle-class background; she's divorced and trying to rebuild her life with her two daughters, Eva and Alice. The two meet by chance and recognize each other: they had a fling as teenagers, many years earlier. Yet first love is never forgotten, and so Giulio and Lucia find themselves together again. Their meeting, however, changes not only the lives of a man and a woman, but also those of two families as different as could be. Two families who find themselves living under the same roof without even having had the time to get to know each other well.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When Lucia and Giulio, former lovers, reunite after years, sparks fly and a new, chaotic extended family is born in the heart of Garbatella. Between secret loves, teenage jealousies, long-standing friendships, and everyday hassles, the Cesaronis learn to know, love, and survive under the same roof.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The second season delves into the dynamics of the extended family. Marco and Eva navigate their secret love amidst countless difficulties, facing jealousy and attempts at separation. Lucia feels increasingly suffocated by the Cesaronis' intrusiveness, while Giulio tries to keep the family together. New relationships are explored, and the children grow up, facing important choices about friendship and romance.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In the third season of the series, the Cesaroni brothers will face problems to solve with their usual wisdom and cheerfulness, but also pranks, challenges, and bets. Stefania and Lucia, close friends at school and in life, will also experience a thousand adventures, such as when they end up competing to determine who has the better husband, and they will do anything to win.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Following the birth of Marco and Eva's baby girl, season four flashes forward a year and a half. Many things have changed in Garbatella: Marco and Eva have left for a tour, Cesare and Pamela are about to get married, and Lucia has started working in a museum in Venice, a development that doesn't please Giulio.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The fifth season of the series opens with Giulio and Mimmo returning from vacation, where they meet Lucia, who's in Rome for an art exhibition. Rudi also returns to Garbatella, having left for the summer to visit some cities alone, hoping to forget Miriam. Marco also returns, but, not wanting to live at home, he stays with an old friend.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: In the sixth season, Giulio is the undisputed protagonist, and all the other stories unfold around him. Lucia temporarily moves to New York to help Eva with little Marta, and Giulio, with the arrival of the other Cesaroni siblings, finds himself alone managing a family that's bigger than ever.

seasons.name: The Return
seasons.overview: In Garbatella, the Cesaronis start over, reconnecting with new relationships and old scores. Giulio holds together the house and the wine shop, amidst debts and a new business partner. Marco juggles Virginia, little Adriano, and Marta's return. Mimmo makes his debut at school as a special education teacher, while Rudi works as a janitor. Between responsibilities and mistakes, they learn to start over.

title: The Cesaronis
